PROP-57888860-inv-024.text: Batch verification weight accumulation must correctly sum r_powers per unique commitment index.
PROP-57888860-inv-024.assertion: forall verify_batch: weights[commitment_indices[k]] == sum(r_powers[j] for j where commitment_indices[j] == commitment_indices[k])

locations.note: Weight accumulation logic is in c-kzg-4844 library; Grandine wrapper deduplicates commitments before FFI call (lines 33-36) but does not implement r_powers summation
